
| Prefix | Namespace | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| `wl:` | `https://worklode.io/ns/ontology#` | classes and properties |
| `wlc:` | `https://worklode.io/ns/concept/` | SKOS concepts |
| `wlid:` | `https://worklode.io/ns/id/` | instances |
| (graphs) | `https://worklode.io/ns/graph/` | named graphs |

Graph IRIs are names, not locators: no route on `lode-server` serves them. The cockpit's own URLs (`/projects/<proj>/<kind>/<n>` and the redirects onto them) are a separate scheme, defined in WL-SPEC-83.
